headline: ASML and Tata Partner to Build India's First 300-mm Semiconductor Fab, Reshaping Global Supply Chains
summary: The strategic partnership between ASML and Tata Electronics to establish a 300-mm semiconductor fabrication plant in India marks a pivotal development in global semiconductor manufacturing, directly boosting India's AI infrastructure ambitions and industrial self-reliance. This major business move signifies a significant geographic diversification of the critical semiconductor supply chain, driven by geopolitical imperatives to de-risk and build resilience against future disruptions.
